title: Allowing for Payments Already Collected Against a Resort Lodging Stay
content:
Money already collected against a Resort Lodging stay is allowed for when the deposit is asked for, so that the household is never asked twice for the same money. What is allowed for is read from the payment entries standing on the reservation's folio.

Where the folio carries payments already collected against the stay totalling the deposit share worked out or more, the whole of that share is taken off, and the incidental hold collected in advance is still asked for.

Where the folio carries one or more payments already collected against the stay totalling less than the share worked out, the whole of those payments is taken off.

Where the folio carries no payment already collected against the stay, nothing is taken off.

| What the folio shows | What is taken off |
| --- | --- |
| Payments totalling the deposit share worked out or more | the whole of that share, the incidental hold collected in advance still being asked for |
| Payments totalling less than the share worked out | the whole of those payments |
| No payment against the stay | nothing |

### Both sides of the boundary (hypothetical folios, on a deposit share worked out at 600.00 USD)

A folio carrying payments of 600.00 USD in total reaches the share worked out, so the whole 600.00 USD share is taken off, and the incidental hold collected in advance is still asked for; reaching the share is enough and the payments need not exceed it.

A folio carrying payments of 250.00 USD in total falls short of the share worked out, so the whole 250.00 USD is taken off.

A folio carrying no payment at all against the stay has nothing taken off.
